title: Annual comprehensive report.
bodyText: The authority shall submit an annual comprehensive report on the progress of the program to the legislature no later than twenty days prior to the convening of each regular session.
bodyHtml: §206E-249  Annual comprehensive report.  The authority shall submit an annual comprehensive report on the progress of the program to the legislature no later than twenty days prior to the convening of each regular session. [L 2022, c 184, pt of §1; am L 2025, c 252, §5]
